doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing thanks and playing as long as he can
summary: Young says playing music is fun and he will continue as long as he can, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: We all hope you will continue… Young:…because it‘s so much fun, to me, to play music. It really is, it‘s a lot of fun to play music, and it‘s kind of tough too, you know. You a musician, so you know what I mean, but I enjoy playing music and I‘m going to continue to play as long as I can.
